domain_rationale: Correctness rests on radioactive-decay physics as a health physicist applies it: the exponential decay law with the half-life expressed in days over an actual calendar day count, secular-equilibrium daughter activity scaled by the branching fraction, and which of the parent, daughter or total activity each radiation-safety threshold (exempt quantity, leak-test threshold, location limit, ten-half-life decay-to-disposal) is judged on. The inventory and report are only the carrier.
competing_pair_rejected_because: The compliance determinations are simple threshold comparisons once the physics figures are right; every departure and both restraint traps sit in decay correction, day counting, equilibrium-daughter accounting and the definition of what a store holds, which is health-physics reasoning rather than regulatory workflow.
evidence: instruction.md: the requested outcome is a survey whose current activities, daughter activities and threshold calls follow manual RPO-7 (decay law, 365.25-day year, Gregorian day count, equilibrium daughters)
environment/app/docs/source-inventory-manual.md sections 1-7: half-life table, A = A_ref x 2^(-t/T), secular equilibrium with branching fraction, total vs parent activity per threshold

planned verifier (phase 2): compares the whole survey report (activity_bq, daughter_bq, flags, held_bq, fraction_of_limit) against expectations sealed from solution/model.py, which re-derives them from the manual
